title: Daily Market Digest: Inflation Data in Focus Amid Mixed Global Cues
subtitle: Wednesday, August 12, 2026

items.headline: S&P 500 Edges Up Ahead of Crucial CPI Report; Oil Prices Climb on Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: The S&P 500 saw a modest gain today, rising 0.06% as investors keenly await the release of the latest U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) report. This comes after major U.S. indices pulled back on Tuesday. Meanwhile, crude oil prices are continuing their ascent, driven by persistent geopolitical uncertainty in the Middle East.

items.headline: Quantum Soars on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Quantum ($QMCO) shares jumped approximately 65% after the company reported better-than-expected first-quarter financial results and issued second-quarter guidance above analyst estimates.

items.headline: CoreWeave Jumps as Revenue Doubles
items.summary: CoreWeave ($CRWV) shares saw a significant increase as the company announced its revenue doubled from the year-ago period, indicating strong demand for its cloud computing services amidst the AI boom.

items.headline: Cardinal Health Rises Post-Earnings
items.summary: Cardinal Health Inc. ($CAH) shares gained 1.3% after the healthcare services company posted its fourth-quarter results, which were well-received by the market.

items.headline: YXT.COM Group Plunges on Offering
items.summary: YXT.COM GROUP HOLDING LIMITED ($YXT) stock plummeted 66.07% following its announcement of the pricing of a $1.05 million registered direct offering.

items.headline: ThredUp Declines on Q2 Results
items.summary: ThredUp Inc. ($TDUP) shares fell 50.48% after the company announced its second-quarter 2026 financial results, which disappointed investors.

items.headline: Suja Life Reports Steep Q2 Losses
items.summary: Suja Life, Inc. ($SUJA) saw its stock drop by 46.18% following the release of its second-quarter 2026 financial results, reflecting a challenging period for the company.

items.headline: U.S. CPI Report Due Today, Expected to Show Inflation Cooling
items.summary: The U.S. government is set to release its latest monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) report today. Economists anticipate headline inflation to cool to 3.4% from 3.5% and core inflation to ease to 2.5% from 2.6% in July. This report is crucial for shaping expectations regarding the Federal Reserve's future monetary policy.

items.headline: Energy and Utilities Lead, Consumer Discretionary and Real Estate Lag in US Market
items.summary: On Tuesday, energy and utilities sectors demonstrated resilience, closing higher and bucking the broader market downturn. Conversely, consumer discretionary, real estate, and communication services stocks experienced the largest losses on the S&P 500.

items.headline: Data I/O and Nebius Group Report Q2 Earnings
items.summary: Data I/O ($DAIO) is hosting its Q2 2026 earnings call today at 5:00 PM ET, having previously announced preliminary Q2 net sales rose 59%. Nebius Group ($NBIS) also released its Q2 results before market open, with expectations of continued strong growth driven by its AI-compute capacity. Strauss Group (TASE:STRS) reported solid operating income growth of 42% and doubled net profit for Q2 and H1 2026.

items.headline: Fed Maintains Rates Amidst Mixed Economic Signals, Inflation Remains Key Concern
items.summary: The Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged at 3.50%-3.75% at its July 27 FOMC meeting. However, despite a softening labor market, persistent inflation pressures and elevated oil prices mean the path for future rate decisions remains highly data-dependent.
